paragraphs.source_en: Someone follows me that day as I hunt alone in the winter woods. I wear my new white wolfcloak. They are camouflaged as well. I do not see whoever it is, but he is there. I pretend my bowstring needs fixing and steal a glance back. Nothing. Quiet. Snow. The sound of wind on brittle branches. They still follow as I move along.

units.source_en: Someone follows me that day as I hunt alone in the winter woods.
I wear my new white wolfcloak.
I do not see whoever it is, but he is there.
I pretend my bowstring needs fixing and steal a glance back.
The sound of wind on brittle branches.
They still follow as I move along.

paragraphs.source_en: I feel them behind me. It’s like the ache in my body from my wound. I pretend to see a deer and pass quickly through a thicket only to scramble up a tall pine on the other side.
